name: lovely-yak
description: A compact analytics card with a token gradient rim, two stats, a seven-bar spark, and a local-radius details action.
purpose: Presents a live performance snapshot in the same stacked dashboard-card shape as the Uiverse inspo, without flattening radii through Button.
bestFor: compact live-metric cards with one follow-up action

files.content:
